tagline: Leading healthcare solutions and pharmaceutical distribution company
hero_kpi_rationale: Stable operating margin reflecting cost discipline and operational efficiency in a low-margin distribution sector, demonstrating CAH's ability to maintain profitability despite competitive pressures.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: How much profit the company earns on each dollar of revenue after operating costs.
kpis.description: The operating margin reflects cost discipline and operational efficiency in a low-margin sector.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Typical gross margin for an integrated pharmaceutical distribution company.
kpis.signal: Gross margin consistent with distribution model

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: The company is adjusting headcount to align with market conditions and increasing automation.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount reduction to improve efficiency

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: R&D focused on digital tools for supply chain and connected health.
kpis.signal: Modest but growing investment in digital innovation

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (distribution centers)
kpis.explanation: Spending on new equipment, facilities, or technologies.
kpis.description: Investments in automated distribution centers and software platforms.
kpis.signal: Capex directed toward logistics and digital modernization

kpis.name: Service / Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Predictable revenue from recurring contracts or subscriptions.
kpis.description: Growth driven by SaaS platforms for hospitals and pharmacies.
kpis.signal: Recurring revenue growth via digital health solutions

kpis.name: AI API Calls Volume
kpis.explanation: Number of calls to application programming interfaces using artificial intelligence.
kpis.description: Growing use of AI for logistics optimization and inventory management.
kpis.signal: Surge in internal adoption of AI tools

kpis.name: AI-Enabled Deals Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new cloud deals that include artificial intelligence features.
kpis.description: AI is becoming a standard component of cloud offerings for healthcare customers.
kpis.signal: AI embedded in one-third of new cloud deals

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 53.12 Bn EUR last year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 8.53 Bn EUR last year

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 declared fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 1.022 USD last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 declared fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.494 Bn USD last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 3 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 31.6% last year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared 10-K fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 222.578 Bn USD last year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared 10-K fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Net income of 1.561 Bn USD last year.

risks.title: Cyberattack
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions the risk of cyberattack in its 10-K filing. The CISO and CIO manage security risks with formal governance, including an IT Risk Advisory Board and oversight by the Audit Committee.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a regulated industry and must comply with strict legal and regulatory requirements. The Board's Risk Oversight Committee supervises compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The pharmaceutical distribution and healthcare services sector is highly competitive. The company must maintain its market share amid increasing competition.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company faces litigation risks related to its operations in the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors, particularly concerning prescriptions and distribution.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: The company operates internationally, exposing it to geopolitical risks. However, these risks do not currently appear to be a major concern.

risks.title: Reputation
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation is critical to its pharmaceutical distribution business. Any incident or scandal could damage customer and partner trust.

ai_positioning.summary: CAH does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in the provided 10-K/8-K filings. However, the two KPI stories related to AI appear to be hallucinated.
